title: Our Beginning
text: Northern Lighthouse began in 2017 as Smyrna Bible Baptist Mission - a mission extension from Smyrna Bible Baptist Church of Milan under the leadership of pastor Andy Mananon. For the first years we met in the home of a brother, worshipping and growing together as a small congregation. Those humble beginnings strengthen our close fellowship and desire to grow and spread the Gospel.

images.caption: Early house meetings

title: Moving and Growing
text: After our first years we spent a season meeting in different locations around the city. We moved to different places near Bromma and for about a year we had a place in Norsborg. Finally we worshipped and ministered in Solna for two years where we experienced a considerable growth. In time God led us to Skogås, where the church continues today.

images.caption: Our home church in Solna for 2 years

title: Becoming a Local Church
text: On 12 October 2025 we were organised as an independent local church under the name Northern Lighthouse Bible Baptist Church. The name reflects our calling: our members recognised a need for an uncompromised, Bible-believing congregation — a place of refuge and faithful teaching. At the same time we desire to be a beacon for the lost, holding forth the light of the Gospel in our community.
